statement.description:
Capitalization is writing a word with its first letter as a capital letter. Your task is to capitalize the given word.

Note, that during capitalization all the letters except the first one remains unchanged.
statement.formatI: A single line contains a non-empty word. This word consists of lowercase and uppercase English letters. The length of the word will not exceed $ 10^{3} $ .
statement.formatO: Output the given word after capitalization.

translation.description:
首字母大写是指将一个单词的第一个字母写成大写字母。你的任务是将给定的单词首字母大写。

注意，在首字母大写的过程中，除了第一个字母之外，其余字母保持不变。
translation.formatI: 输入包含一行，一个非空单词。该单词由小写或大写的英文字母组成。单词的长度不超过 $10^{3}$。
translation.formatO: 输出首字母大写后的单词。
